text: StrictImprovement keeps an edit only for a strictly lower score, with no new deterministic key and no new confirmed S5 or S4 key.
The accept score is compared lexicographically: a strict total order on the counts.
When rejects_early is true, keep reverts the edit whatever the reflectors add.
The edit rounds stop at max_edit_rounds and the release rounds at release_edits.
The floor releases only a draft with no floor finding, or a fallback that the code checks pass.
